_doc: Unresolved MSIP-1 design questions. LLMs must NOT treat these as decided.

questions.question: Is MSIP a pure observation/sidecar layer, or does it eventually replace CRT as the interpretation authority?
Does MarketStateVector include CRT state as a first-class dimension, or only non-CRT dimensions (session, vol regime, structure, liquidity)?
Are MSIP dimensions allowed to introduce new formulas, or must they only compose already-certified FM identities?
questions.bias: config-first + ontology-first: prefer compose certified FMs; new formulas require FM registration first

questions.question: What is the publication cadence — same-bar as FeaturePipeline, event-gated like CRT, or multi-timeframe?
Does MSIP bind into EngineRunner / DecisionEngine in phase 1, or remain shadow/telemetry only?
questions.bias: shadow/telemetry first; production binding requires Authority Ladder evidence (ΔG001)

questions.question: How are known consumer encoding debts (session 0/1/2 vs SESSION_MAP; trend_strength name collision; volatility_regime int8 vs s05 strings) handled before MSIP activation?
Is visual validation (charts/overlays) in-scope for MSIP-1 implementation gate, or deferred?
What is the MSIP config section name and ownership relative to crt_engine / engine_runner / fusion?
How is CRT-local ATR/EMA/body_ratio/wick_size proven byte- or tolerance-parity with FeaturePipeline before any MSIP→CRT binding?
Which CRT-private state quantities (active_range refs, sweep_event, displacement_candle memory) must remain forever outside the feature layer?
questions.bias: KEEP_IN_CRT unless a new ontology proves shared market meaning without lookahead

questions.question: Is MSIP a pure observation/sidecar layer, or does it eventually replace CRT as the interpretation authority?
questions.constraint: Phase-1 MUST be shadow/sidecar; CRT remains CLOSED lifecycle authority until reopen + Authority Ladder

questions.question: Does MSIP bind into EngineRunner / DecisionEngine in phase 1, or remain shadow/telemetry only?
questions.constraint: shadow/telemetry only until CRT_INPUT_AUTHORITY_MATRIX migration decisions + parity proofs
